**actnode v0.3.0** — ergonomics: `--latest`, release-notes links, Action PR mode.

- **`--latest`**: suggest the newest release that already runs on the target Node (default stays the smallest major jump). Also available as Action input `latest: true`.
- **Release-notes links**: every finding with a suggested bump includes a `release_notes` URL (`https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/releases/tag/{tag}`). Shown in text (`notes: …`), Markdown (extra column), and JSON.
- **Action PR mode**: set `create-pr: true` (plus optional `pr-branch` / `pr-title`) to apply `--fix` and open or update a pull request when there is a diff. No PR if the diff is empty. Caller needs `contents: write` and `pull-requests: write`.

Docs: https://blackman99.github.io/actnode/docs/
